meta.price_rules: eur_incl_btw = consumer price incl. 21% btw as seen in search snippets. Entries without a 'shop' key are Outmate prices. Entries with shop 'statafelshop' are Statafelshop prices; Statafelshop shows incl. and excl. btw side by side, so eur_excl_btw is given where the snippet had it (a computed value is marked 'computed' in the note). kind: from = 'vanaf' price, fixed = single price, range = see note, approx = rounded. Sale prices are stored as the current price with 'was' in the note. Use as calibration only; our prices are suggestions flagged in docs/claims-to-confirm.md. Market bands from other shops are in market_price_bands.
